definitions.explanation: A story or analogy used to explain or illustrate a point. The story itself serves as a comparison or metaphor for the real topic.

examples.japanese: {例|たと}え{話|ばなし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。

⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{概念|がいねん}→概念：04709_gainen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{例|たと}え{話|ばなし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすく⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The teacher used parables to make difficult concepts easy to understand.

examples.japanese: あまり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{例|たと}え{話|ばなし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、かえって⟦{本題|ほんだい}→本題：12877_hondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えなく→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If there are too many analogies, they can actually obscure the main point.

notes:
USAGE:
{例|たと}え{話|ばなし} refers to any story or comparison used to illustrate a point. It is commonly used in teaching, speeches, and everyday conversation when someone explains something through analogy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {例|たと}え{話|ばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use an analogy)
- {例|たと}え{話|ばなし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (to put it in terms of an analogy)
- {上手|うま}い{例|たと}え{話|ばなし} (a good analogy)

WRITING:
Also written as {喩|たと}え{話|ばなし} or たとえ{話|ばなし}. The ⟦{例|たと}え→例え：04128_tatoe⟧ spelling is the most common.
